propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be emitted in COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload without exceeding 50 microseconds overhead per close.
Timing instrumentation must use only time.monotonic_ns(), integer arithmetic, and dictionary assignments on the existing call path, adding no I/O, subprocess, network call, lock, or model invocation.

Ten specific phase timings (pre_verifier_total_ms, structural_scan_ms, material_policy_ms, descendant_scope_ms, landing_check_ms, verifier_call_ms, git_history_read_ms, alias_index_build_ms, ticket_ref_resolution_ms, diff_validation_ms) must be threaded through the close_ticket call graph and recorded before sidecar emit.

Timing dictionary must be passed as an optional argument through close_ticket → _completion_precheck → _check_work_landed → referencing_commits and _check_file_impact_vs_diff, with backward compatibility for callers that omit it.
Duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and label records lacking them as legacy_uninstrumented without causal operation attribution.
